name: Viral Score Loop
subtitle: Score a draft against your own posts, then sharpen it until the score stops rising.
summary: Scores your draft from 0 to 100 against your own recent posts and says what helped and what hurt. Then it rewrites one thing at a time, keyed on the biggest thing that hurt, and rescores, keeping your facts and voice. It stops when the score stops rising, after six versions, or the moment a warning fires: asking for replies, follows or links never raises the score.
howToAsk: How will this post do? [paste draft]
Score this draft and make it better
Sharpen this before I post it
provide: the draft, and whether it will carry an image or a video.
get: a score for every version with what changed, and the best version on a picker card.
chips: Scored against your own recent posts
